notes: tapFrac is the SCREEN centre of the real rect. The UI lives under AspecterSA (AspectRatioFitter, 1242x2688 = 0.46205) inside a 1080x2400 screen (0.45), so a panel fraction u from the bottom lands at 0.013039 + u*0.973917 of the screen: tapFracY = 0.986961 - 0.973917*u. The JUMP tap is a world/HUD tap zone and needs no correction - it only has to miss the top buttons (y<0.10) and the control hint band (y>0.91).
